name: base-price
title: Base price
description: The required price per 100 g or per litre, worked out from the pack size and price, converted, rounded half up and formatted for the locale.
docs: Pass the price of the pack in minor units, how much one pack holds and its unit; the base price is worked out here, rounded half up to the cent. Give it an id and point the price's aria-describedby at it. computeBasePrice is exported for sorting or analytics.
